title: Journey kit
summary: patcher/journeys/support.mjs launches the built app for patch journeys: a throwaway HOME and T3CODE_HOME seeded with the release launch fixture, Chromium's mock keychain, no Dock icon and no window ever shown or focused (a journey fails if one is), telemetry and auto-update off, logs and screenshots into $T3_PATCHER_EVIDENCE, tearing down Electron's process group under bounded deadlines if setup fails before the first window opens. Every other patch's journeys use it. T3's Vitest suites cap worker concurrency from BSTACK_VERIFY_WORKERS (default 1), and browser tests run in full headless Chromium in their own group order so frames draw on a locked Mac without colliding with unit runs.

checks.name: browser runner
checks.run: . "$T3_PATCHER_ENV" && cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright install chromium && pnpm exec vp test run src/browser/browserDefaults.test.ts src/components/ContextChip.browser.test.tsx src/components/DiffFilePathCopyButton.browser.test.tsx

journeys.name: app_opens
journeys.proves: The built app opens on an isolated home, lists the seeded thread in the sidebar and shows its message when opened.
